FRAME_QUALITY_FAILURE.possible_mitigation: Increase image quality, lower blur, or adjust frame-selection threshold.

INSUFFICIENT_FEATURE_MATCHES.possible_mitigation: Improve overlap, reduce blur/compression, or use more textured views.

CAMERA_POSE_FAILURE.possible_mitigation: Collect a smoother single pass with stronger overlap and more stable exposure.

RECONSTRUCTION_SPARSE.possible_mitigation: Increase usable frames or improve feature support before dense reconstruction.

GEOREFERENCE_FAILURE.possible_mitigation: Provide usable GPS metadata or better timestamp correspondence.

OBJECT_DETECTION_FAILURE.possible_mitigation: Check detector model/classes and image quality.

OBJECT_3D_ASSOCIATION_FAILURE.possible_mitigation: Improve calibrated multi-view support for tracked objects.

INSUFFICIENT_GEOMETRY.possible_mitigation: Avoid measuring weakly reconstructed or unseen regions.

MEASUREMENT_LOW_EVIDENCE.possible_mitigation: Use endpoints with higher reconstruction support or collect better views.

DYNAMIC_OBJECT_CONTAMINATION.possible_mitigation: Mask dynamic candidates and compare raw vs dynamic-aware reconstruction.

OCCLUSION.possible_mitigation: Report occluded surfaces as low evidence; do not infer hidden geometry.

PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.possible_mitigation: Profile stages, downsample for evaluation, or set explicit time budgets.

UNKNOWN.possible_mitigation: Inspect logs and add a more specific classifier rule.
